rules.name: Unusual Claim Amount
rules.description: Claim amount significantly exceeds the expected value for this policy type.
rules.backward_question: Does the claim amount significantly exceed the expected value for this policy type?

rules.name: Claim Near Policy Limit
rules.description: Claim amount is close to the maximum policy coverage limit.
rules.backward_question: Is the claim amount close to the maximum policy coverage limit?

rules.name: Round-Number Claim
rules.description: Claim amount is a suspiciously round figure, common in fabricated claims.
rules.backward_question: Is the claim amount an unusually round figure?

rules.name: Repeated Claim Pattern
rules.description: Customer has multiple previous claims within a short time window.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer have multiple previous claims in a short period?

rules.name: High Claim Frequency
rules.description: Customer files claims more frequently than the population average.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer file claims more often than average?

rules.name: Prior Confirmed Fraud
rules.description: Customer has at least one prior confirmed fraud record.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer have a prior confirmed fraud record?

rules.name: Multiple Claims Short Window
rules.description: Two or more claims filed within a 30-day window.
rules.backward_question: Were multiple claims filed within a short (30-day) window?

rules.name: Early Claim After Policy Start
rules.description: Claim was filed shortly after the policy started (classic staged-loss pattern).
rules.backward_question: Was the claim filed shortly after the policy started?

rules.name: Document Inconsistency
rules.description: Submitted documents are incomplete or contain inconsistencies.
rules.backward_question: Do the supporting documents contain inconsistencies or gaps?

rules.name: Accident-Report Date Mismatch
rules.description: Police report date does not align with the reported accident date.
rules.backward_question: Does the police report date align with the accident date?

rules.name: Missing Police Report
rules.description: No police report on file for an accident type that requires one.
rules.backward_question: Is a police report missing for an accident type that requires one?

rules.name: Damage-Description Mismatch
rules.description: Reported damage does not match the accident description or photos.
rules.backward_question: Does the reported damage match the accident description?

rules.name: Vehicle Age vs Damage Mismatch
rules.description: Extent of damage is inconsistent with the vehicle's age/condition.
rules.backward_question: Is the claimed damage disproportionate to the vehicle's age?

rules.name: High-Risk Geographic Zone
rules.description: Accident/claim location falls within a zone with historically high fraud rates.
rules.backward_question: Is the claim location within a historically high-fraud zone?

rules.name: Premium Payment Irregularity
rules.description: Premium payments show gaps or late payments prior to the claim.
rules.backward_question: Were premium payments irregular before the claim was filed?

rules.name: Policy Nearing Expiry
rules.description: Claim filed close to policy expiry/renewal, a known staged-claim window.
rules.backward_question: Was the claim filed shortly before policy expiry?

rules.name: No Witnesses Reported
rules.description: Accident report lists no witnesses despite occurring in a populated area.
rules.backward_question: Does the accident report lack any witnesses?

rules.name: Inconsistent Claimant Statement
rules.description: Claimant's statement contains internal contradictions versus the report.
rules.backward_question: Is the claimant's statement consistent with the official report?

rules.name: Multiple Policies Same Vehicle
rules.description: Same vehicle is insured under more than one active policy.
rules.backward_question: Is the vehicle insured under more than one active policy?

rules.name: Total Loss with Low Mileage
rules.description: Vehicle declared a total loss despite unusually low recorded mileage/usage.
rules.backward_question: Is a near-new vehicle being declared a total loss?

rules.name: Customer Age Risk Profile
rules.description: Statistical fraud-risk association with certain claimant age brackets (used only as a weak supporting signal).
rules.backward_question: Does the claimant fall into a higher statistical risk age bracket?

rules.name: Financial Red Flag (Composite)
rules.description: Combines unusual claim amount with early-claim timing.
rules.backward_question: Are there financial anomalies combined with suspicious claim timing?

rules.name: Financial Red Flag (Repeated Pattern)
rules.description: Combines unusual claim amount with a repeated claim pattern.
rules.backward_question: Are there financial anomalies combined with a repeated claim pattern?

rules.name: History Red Flag (Fraud + Repetition)
rules.description: Combines repeated claims with a prior confirmed fraud record.
rules.backward_question: Does claim history show both repetition and a prior fraud record?

rules.name: History Red Flag (Repetition Only)
rules.description: Repeated claim pattern or high claim frequency alone.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer show a repeated or unusually frequent claim pattern?

rules.name: History Red Flag (Prior Fraud Only)
rules.description: Prior confirmed fraud alone is sufficient to raise the history flag.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer have a prior confirmed fraud record?

rules.name: Evidence Red Flag (Documents + Damage)
rules.description: Combines document inconsistency with damage mismatch.
rules.backward_question: Are the documents inconsistent AND is there a damage mismatch?

rules.name: Evidence Red Flag (Report Issues)
rules.description: Report inconsistency or a report/accident date mismatch.
rules.backward_question: Is the accident report inconsistent with the claim or its own timeline?

rules.name: Evidence Red Flag (Missing Police Report)
rules.description: Police report missing where required.
rules.backward_question: Is a required police report missing from the claim file?

rules.name: Fraud Hypothesis (Financial + Evidence)
rules.description: Top-level rule: financial anomalies combined with inconsistent evidence.
rules.backward_question: Are there financial anomalies AND inconsistent supporting evidence?

rules.name: Fraud Hypothesis (History + Evidence)
rules.description: Top-level rule: suspicious claim history combined with inconsistent evidence.
rules.backward_question: Does the claim history look suspicious AND is the evidence inconsistent?

rules.name: Fraud Hypothesis (History + Financial)
rules.description: Top-level rule: suspicious claim history combined with financial anomalies.
rules.backward_question: Does the claim history look suspicious AND are there financial anomalies?

rules.name: Fraud Hypothesis (Direct Prior Fraud)
rules.description: Top-level rule: a prior confirmed fraud record alone, combined with any current-claim anomaly, is enough to flag.
rules.backward_question: Does the customer have a prior fraud record AND does this claim show inconsistent evidence?
